mike (Support): hey @customer_jane, saw your ticket — 401 invalid_api_key right after you rotated keys? can you paste the exact curl you used (redact key) and how you fetched the secret from Secrets Manager?
customer_jane (Customer): thanks mike. i used AWS CLI to pull the secret then exported it. command i ran: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id prod/redwood/key)` then `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat` -> 401 invalid_api_key
anya (Support): thanks — aws returns a JSON blob for get-secret-value unless you ask for text. do you see `SecretString` in the output?
customer_jane (Customer): yes the first command printed something like `{\"ARN\":...,\"Name\":...,\"SecretString\":\"{\\\"key\\\":\\\"rwd_live_xxx...\\\"}\"}` so i probably copied that whole thing by accident :/
mike (Support): yup that will do it. REDWOOD_API_KEY ended up being the entire JSON with escaped quotes/backslashes. that's a malformed key -> 401. quick repro: `echo \"{\\\"key\\\":\\\"rwd_live_BOGUS\\\"}\"` decodes to a string that is not a valid token.
deepak (Security): can you confirm the token string contained extra braces or backslashes when you echoed it? e.g. `echo \"$REDWOOD_API_KEY\"` should show only `rwd_...` not `\"{\\\"key\\\":`
customer_jane (Customer): i just checked — `echo $REDWOOD_API_KEY` shows `{"key":"rwd_live_abcd1234..."}` (so yes, the JSON wrapper is in there).
anya (Support): fix is to extract SecretString properly. either: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id prod/redwood/key --query SecretString --output text)` or if SecretString is itself JSON do `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id prod/redwood/key --query SecretString --output text | jq -r .key)`
mike (Support): also check for extra newline/CR at the end: `printf '%s' \"$REDWOOD_API_KEY\" | xxd` will show hidden bytes. good to validate before curl.
customer_jane (Customer): ok trying now — used `--query SecretString --output text | jq -r .key` and curl succeeded (200). thanks!! :tada:
rotations-bot: notice: key rwd_live_abcd1234... has been marked rotated by user jane@example.com at 2026-03-18T17:12:34Z
deepak (Security): please mark this as resolved but add a doc blurb for common secretmanager pitfalls, and recommend the `--output text` pattern in our KB.
mike (Support): will do, adding to KB and closing the loop with customer.
customer_jane (Customer): appreciate the quick help :heart:
